text:
maria: quick brainstorm  the continuous coalesce admits nearly everything and small tenants see jitter. proposal: lightweight admission gate that returns ADMIT_FASTPATH | ADMIT_WARMUP | DEFER_TO_BATCHER. gate only decides, scheduler executes.
kevin: makes sense. admission should be a pure enum + reason tag. how do we pick criteria? tokens, deadline_hints, recent kv-warmup history?
maria: start simple: token thresholds + deadline_hint. add per-tenant credit windows to avoid abuse. toy proto: fastpath.max_tokens=32, fastpath.rate_per_tenant=100/min; warmup.range=33-256, credit_window=10s.
jamal: watch KV-cache interactions: too many fastpath hits may reduce warm cache effectiveness for long sequences. warmup lane should encourage cache warmups.
erin: ops concerns: if fastpath pool saturates, auto-downgrade to DEFER_TO_BATCHER. ops-bot should alert when saturation >75%.
ops-bot: alert: fastpath-utilization=79% on pool-a - suggest scale or reduce credits.
maria: rollout: sim-mode (increment "would_fastpath" metric but return DEFER_TO_BATCHER) for 48h; then gated enable 1% per-box -> 10%. A/B with canary tenants and kill-switch at router.
kevin: add sim-mode traces, per-path histograms, and labeled reasons (e.g., "over_rate", "deadline_ok").
jamal: long-term: consider tiny scoring model for admission, but deterministic gates first.
erin: next: maria drafts RFC with enums, proto, telemetry and rollout; kevin/jamal run sims; i'll wire ops alerts.
maria: I'll share RFC + sim CSV by EOD Friday. thanks! :tada:
